rows.en: ＠０１０＿０１２＊Sakaki＊Hello.￥Mind if I come in for a moment?＝＠０１０＿０１３Sorry to bother you while you're￥resting, but there's something I￥need to check. A mail just...
＠０１０＿０１４＊Sakaki＊Ah, it's arrived.￥So the connection is fine...
＊Sakaki＊＠０１０＿０１５It goes live tomorrow, but...￥your console now has a function￥for sending and receiving mail.＝＠０１０＿０１６＊Sakaki＊The system is old, so sending￥takes quite a while, though...
＊Sakaki＊＠０１０＿０１７It lets candidates keep in touch￥without going to the facilities.
＠０１０＿０１８＊Sakaki＊For instance, when you want to￥change someone's mood...＝＠０１０＿０１９It might work better than seeing￥them in person, you know?
＠０１０＿０２０＊Sakaki＊Not that you seem all that shy.
＊Sakaki＊＠０１０＿０２１Well, how you use it is￥up to you.＝＠０１０＿０２２Put it to good use.
